title: Mississauga Mayoral Election Poll
summary: A new poll suggests that Doug Ford's endorsement of Carolyn Parrish for Mississauga mayor may be backfiring. The poll shows Parrish and Bonnie Crombie are tied in the race. The municipal election is set to take place in October. The poll was conducted by Liaison Strategies. The results indicate a close contest between the two candidates.
summary_points: A new poll shows Carolyn Parrish and Bonnie Crombie are tied in the Mississauga mayoral election
The poll was conducted by Liaison Strategies
The municipal election is set to take place in October
Doug Ford endorsed Carolyn Parrish for Mississauga mayor
The endorsement may be backfiring according to the poll
